subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published and verified through every supported install channel, and are maintainers ready to accept the fail-closed AWS upgrade impact?
rationale: The code path is intentionally correct only with the newer provider attestation contract; merging earlier can make existing AWS worker provisioning unavailable, while adding a fallback would weaken the security boundary and require a separate product decision.

options.title: Verify rollout, then merge
options.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify supported installation paths and the refreshed merge result, then land the PR.

options.title: Accept a temporary outage window
options.body: Merge before channel rollout only if maintainers explicitly accept that AWS cloud-worker provisioning on older Crabbox installations will fail closed.

options.title: Pause the release
options.body: Keep the PR open if the provider rollout cannot be coordinated without an unacceptable upgrade or availability impact.

recommendation.title: Verify rollout, then merge
recommendation.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify supported installation paths and the refreshed merge result, then land the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the cloud-worker design and this coordinated OpenClaw and Crabbox hardening series.
